title: Maker Take
description: Quite a few random stuff like drinks tools and some explosions.
body:
This adds a lot of random things some from me and some of the things where some peoples ideas but this is just a thing I made as a fun test to see how good I can mod.

This adds:

  -A command called gm to allow to switch gamemodes easily
  
  -a gamerule to change how much coffee you can drink before exploding
  
The items it adds are:

  -The Wind Skiver [A Dash Weapon]
  
  -A cup of tea [Dont drink too much]
  
  -A "cuppa joe] [Also Dont drink too much]
  
  Monster Energy Drink {Original and White} [With Cans too!]
  
  -Dr Pepper [I love this drink so why not make a item and can!]
  
  Tea Cup & Mug
  
  -Super Coco Beans [A Item made for making the "Cuppa Joe" tho dont eat it by itself]
  
Those are the the items that can be obtained in survival but there are...

  -Cod Flavored Dr Pepper [My sanity lowered but it good... till the effects wear off...]
  
  -Advar Cerat [A name I randomly made in my head but a mace weapon that you can dash with also my first coded item!]
  
  -Convar Devian [Another Randomly generated name my mind made up but same as before BUT dash 3 times before long cooldown]
  

And that is it to my recollection there are effects that some of the items give but are basicaly part of its fuction.

Well to those who see this enjoy my first mod!
